tools.name: get_line_status
tools.description: Check TfL's current status and disruptions for exact London line IDs. With no IDs, returns Underground lines only.

line_ids.description: Exact line IDs, for example victoria, central or elizabeth. Omit for all Tube lines.

tools.name: find_stops
tools.description: Find London stops by name or bus stop code. Ask the user to choose if multiple stops match; use the returned ID for arrivals.

tools.name: get_arrivals
tools.description: Get upcoming TfL arrival predictions for an exact stop ID returned by find_stops. Times are UTC and predictions can change. Empty predictions do not establish service status.
